claim.claim-text: a control unit configured to calculate uplink transmission power information based on a pathloss; and a transmission unit configured to transmit, to a base station, control information in which the uplink transmission power information is set, wherein the uplink transmission power information is associated with an ID of a set of a reference signal.
2. The terminal as claimed in claim 1, wherein the reference signal is a sounding reference signal.
3. A communication method executed by a terminal, comprising:

calculating uplink transmission power information based on a pathloss; and transmitting, to a base station, control information in which the uplink transmission power information is set, wherein the uplink transmission power information is associated with an ID of a set of a reference signal.
